budgetBasis: Declared before the measurements were taken, with headroom rather than a fitted value: FAST is two minutes; BATCH is thirty minutes, about twice the observed full tools discovery, so a slower machine or a larger suite does not silently become a failure of the budget; BOUNDARY is ten minutes; SEAL is two hours for the whole verify suite including a rebuild; EXTERNAL is one hour for a party outside this project. The TOTAL is three hours. No waiver is declared, and none can be granted: no authority records one.
note: peakRssMiB is a maximum per tier, wallSeconds, cpuSeconds and artefactsBytes are sums.
